# Setline — full agent brief

## Index

# Setline

Build the plan once. Follow it precisely every day.

## What it is

- Mobile-first workout execution for a structured programme
- Exact authored exercise and set order
- Explicit recorded, calculated, adjusted, and unavailable values
- Device-first active workouts with optional private sync
